relationships.subject: EZH2
relationships.evidence_quote: This upregulation of EZH2 results in the enhanced expression of proinflammatory cytokines/chemokines

relationships.subject: HDAC4
relationships.evidence_quote: Runx2, known to stimulate chondrocyte hypertrophy and MMP-13 production, is inhibited by HDAC4

relationships.subject: HDAC1
relationships.evidence_quote: OA chondrocytes were found to have elevated levels of HDACs 1 and 2 which can inhibit the expression of key anabolic factors Col2α1 and ACAN

relationships.subject: DOT1L
relationships.evidence_quote: it inhibits sirtuin 1 (SIRT1), a highly conserved deacetylase that contributes to OA progression

relationships.subject: KDM6B
relationships.evidence_quote: KDM6B is associated with chondrocyte hypertrophy by increasing Runt-related transcription factor 2 (RUNX2) and Indian hedgehog (IHH) signaling

relationships.subject: EED deficiency
relationships.evidence_quote: EED deficiency decreases Hif1α, ultimately leading to hypoxic cell death

key_findings: Review of epigenetic regulators (DNA methylation, histone methylation/acetylation, PRC2/EZH2, ncRNAs) in osteoarthritis.
HDAC1/2 elevated in OA chondrocytes suppress anabolic genes; EZH2 upregulation promotes cytokines and MMP-mediated catabolism.
